'''2013 Worlds Day 1 Aaron Kia LS Sai'torr Kal Fas (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kia]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (Virtual Block 1)|Sai'torr Kal Fas (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
